tools.name: mobile_dump_ui
tools.description: Get a detailed hierarchy of all interactive UI elements on the current screen, including their positions, text, and attributes. Use this when you want to navigate or take actions.

tools.name: mobile_tap
tools.description: Simulate a tap gesture at specific x,y coordinates on the screen to interact with UI elements

tools.name: mobile_swipe
tools.description: Perform a swipe gesture from one coordinate to another, optionally specifying duration in milliseconds

tools.name: mobile_type
tools.description: Input text into the currently focused text field or input box

tools.name: mobile_key_press
tools.description: Simulate pressing a specific key or button (e.g., 'enter', 'back', 'home')

tools.name: mobile_screenshot
tools.description: Capture the current screen state as an image, useful for visual verification or when UI hierarchy is insufficient.

tools.name: mobile_list_packages
tools.description: List all installed packages on the device, optionally filtered by a search term

tools.name: mobile_open_app
tools.description: Open an application using its package name

tools.name: mobile_init
tools.description: Use this command to initalize mobile device.
